newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trades up $2 at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trades up $2 at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was turning fairly active in the panhandle area by mid-day Tuesday, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers $2.00 higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 9,700 slaughter steers and 6,600 heifers; 49,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 32,300 formulated and 1,100 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week. Note all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 66.00; Carcass Basis 105.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 66.00; Carcass Basis 105.00.
